outline: This course aims to study the peculiarity, scope, theories, and research methodology on learning psychology. Topics include behavioral approaches, cognitive approaches and other related theories, types of learning, and applications of learning theories.
schedule:
01 2/23 Course introduction and description, overall overview of learning psychology
02 3/02 The physiological mechanism of learning (1): Brain and Learning
03 3/09 The physiological mechanism of learning (2): Cognitive Neuroscience-Attention
04 3/16 The Physiological Mechanism of Learning (3): Cognitive Neuroscience-Perception
05 3/23 The Physiological Mechanism of Learning (4): Cognitive Neuroscience-Memory
06 3/30 The Theory of Constraining Learning: Behaviorism 1
07 4/06 No class
08 4/13 The Theory of Constraining Learning: Behaviorism 2
09 4/20 Midterm Week
10 4/27 Bandura Social Learning Theory
11 5/04 Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs & Milgram Obedience to Authority experiment
12 5/11 Cognitive Constructivism & Social Constructivism
13 5/18 Cooperative Learning & Problem Based Learning in Constructivism
14 5/25 Comparison of Behavioral, Cognitive, Developmental, Social Cognitive & Constructivist Perspectives
15 6/01 Motivation Theory
16 6/08 Final Presentation 1
17 6/15 Final Presentation 2
18 6/22 Final week
scorePolicy:
